reading: The prime minister's spokesperson urged broadcasters to act responsibly while expressing no interest in hearing Edwards' account following criticism of new interviews.
Edwards, who was convicted in 2024 of offences involving indecent images of children, has been interviewed for a Channel 4 documentary and a podcast by the Observer and Tortoise Media.
A Downing Street spokesperson placed the interests of victims of child sexual abuse and exploitation at the forefront of the government's response.
Pressed on whether Channel 4 had acted irresponsibly, the spokesperson affirmed the broadcaster's editorial autonomy in choosing programmes and contributors.
Channel 4 defended the documentary, saying its director had subjected Edwards' account to scrutiny without treating any questions as off limits.
Dame Caroline Dinenage, chair of the House of Commons culture and media select committee, warned that media outlets should not merely provide a platform for Edwards.
She also called for examination of whether Edwards would return more than £200,000 paid by the BBC after his first arrest.
Three people who had previously spoken to BBC News about allegations of inappropriate behaviour by Edwards also criticised the interviews.
An anonymous person unconnected to the criminal case interpreted the appearances as an attempt at reputational repair.
Duncan Craig, head of We Are Survivors, said the companies appeared to be overlooking victims' interests.
He also objected to the timing, describing the media as being in a period of reckoning over abuse.
Although Craig endorsed rehabilitation in principle, he questioned whether these programmes amounted to it.
In a promotional clip, interviewer Ceri Thomas expressed curiosity about how a man of Edwards' prominence had reached such a disastrous position.
Journalist Sangita Myska condemned the documentary as an exercise in restoring Edwards' reputation.
Broadcaster Richard Bacon disputed that characterisation, arguing that making a documentary about someone did not, in itself, constitute rehabilitation.

vocabulary.definition: Freedom to decide what to publish or broadcast and how to present it, without those decisions being directed by an outside authority.
Close, critical examination intended to identify weaknesses, inconsistencies or matters requiring explanation.
Excluded from what people are permitted to discuss or investigate.
An opportunity to reach a public audience and present an account or viewpoint, without necessarily receiving the publisher's endorsement.
An effort to improve how someone is publicly regarded after their conduct has damaged their standing.
A period when past wrongdoing receives sustained attention and prompts demands for those responsible to answer for their actions.
As a general position or belief, without necessarily supporting a particular practical instance.
The state of being widely recognised and occupying a position that attracts public attention.
A description that presents something in a particular way and may reflect the speaker's interpretation.
To qualify as something or have the essential features that make that description applicable.

entries.ja: 外部の権力や機関に決定を左右されることなく、何を掲載・放送し、どのように伝えるかを決める自由。
entries.ko: 외부 기관이나 권한을 가진 주체의 지시를 받지 않고 무엇을 출판하거나 방송할지, 또 어떻게 전달할지를 결정할 자유.
entries.zh-Hans: 自主决定发表或播出什么内容以及如何呈现的自由，不受外部权威的指挥。
entries.es: Libertad para decidir qué publicar o emitir y cómo presentarlo, sin que una autoridad externa dirija esas decisiones.
entries.pt-BR: Liberdade para decidir o que publicar ou transmitir e como apresentar esse conteúdo, sem que uma autoridade externa determine essas decisões.
entries.fr: Liberté de décider quoi publier ou diffuser et comment le présenter, sans que ces décisions soient dictées par une autorité extérieure.
entries.de: Die Freiheit, selbst zu entscheiden, was veröffentlicht oder ausgestrahlt und wie es dargestellt wird, ohne dass eine äußere Instanz diese Entscheidungen vorgibt.

entries.ja: 弱点や矛盾、説明が必要な点を見つけるために、細かく批判的に検討すること。
entries.ko: 약점이나 모순, 설명이 필요한 사항을 찾아내기 위해 면밀하고 비판적으로 검토하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 为找出薄弱之处、前后不一致之处或需要解释的问题而进行的细致、批判性的审查。
entries.es: Examen minucioso y crítico destinado a detectar puntos débiles, incoherencias o cuestiones que requieren explicación.
entries.pt-BR: Análise cuidadosa e crítica feita para identificar pontos fracos, inconsistências ou questões que precisam de explicação.
entries.fr: Examen attentif et critique visant à repérer des faiblesses, des incohérences ou des points nécessitant une explication.
entries.de: Eine genaue, kritische Prüfung, die Schwächen, Unstimmigkeiten oder erklärungsbedürftige Punkte aufdecken soll.

entries.ja: 話し合ったり調べたりすることが認められる範囲から除外されていること。
entries.ko: 사람들이 논의하거나 조사하도록 허용된 범위에서 제외된 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 被排除在允许讨论或调查的范围之外。
entries.es: Excluido de los temas que se permite discutir o investigar.
entries.pt-BR: Excluído dos assuntos que as pessoas têm permissão para discutir ou investigar.
entries.fr: Exclu des sujets qu’il est permis d’aborder ou d’examiner.
entries.de: Von dem ausgeschlossen, was besprochen oder untersucht werden darf.

entries.ja: 広く人々に向けて自分の説明や見解を伝える機会。ただし、掲載・放送する側から必ずしも支持を受けるわけではない。
entries.ko: 대중에게 자신의 설명이나 관점을 전달할 기회로, 이를 싣거나 방송하는 매체의 지지를 반드시 받는 것은 아님.
entries.zh-Hans: 向公众讲述事情经过或表达观点的机会，但不一定意味着获得发布方的认可或支持。
entries.es: Oportunidad de llegar al público y presentar un relato o punto de vista, sin recibir necesariamente el respaldo del medio que lo publica o difunde.
entries.pt-BR: Oportunidade de alcançar o público e apresentar um relato ou ponto de vista, sem necessariamente receber o apoio do veículo que o publica ou transmite.
entries.fr: Possibilité de s’adresser au public pour présenter un récit ou un point de vue, sans nécessairement bénéficier du soutien du média qui le publie ou le diffuse.
entries.de: Eine Gelegenheit, ein öffentliches Publikum zu erreichen und eine Schilderung oder Sichtweise darzulegen, ohne dabei zwangsläufig die Zustimmung des veröffentlichenden Mediums zu erhalten.

entries.ja: ある人の行動によってその人の社会的評価が損なわれた後に、世間からの見られ方を改善しようとする取り組み。
entries.ko: 어떤 사람의 행동으로 그 사람의 평판이 나빠진 뒤, 그 사람에 대한 대중의 인식을 개선하려는 노력.
entries.zh-Hans: 某人的行为损害了自身声誉后，为改善公众对其看法而作出的努力。
entries.es: Esfuerzo por mejorar la opinión pública sobre alguien después de que su conducta haya dañado su reputación.
entries.pt-BR: Esforço para melhorar a forma como alguém é visto pelo público depois que sua conduta prejudicou sua reputação.
entries.fr: Effort visant à améliorer l’image d’une personne auprès du public après que sa conduite a nui à sa réputation.
entries.de: Der Versuch, das öffentliche Ansehen einer Person zu verbessern, nachdem ihr Verhalten ihren Ruf geschädigt hat.

entries.ja: 過去の不正や不適切な行為に継続的な関心が向けられ、責任のある人々に自らの行為について説明し、責任を負うよう求める声が上がる時期。
entries.ko: 과거의 잘못에 지속적인 관심이 쏠리고, 그 책임자들이 자신의 행동에 책임을 져야 한다는 요구가 제기되는 시기.
entries.zh-Hans: 过去的不当行为持续受到关注，并引发要求相关责任人为自身行为承担责任的时期。
entries.es: Periodo en el que las malas acciones del pasado reciben atención sostenida y generan exigencias de que los responsables rindan cuentas por sus actos.
entries.pt-BR: Período em que condutas indevidas do passado recebem atenção contínua e provocam cobranças para que os responsáveis respondam por seus atos.
entries.fr: Période durant laquelle des actes répréhensibles du passé font l’objet d’une attention soutenue et suscitent des demandes pour que les responsables répondent de leurs actes.
entries.de: Eine Zeit, in der früheres Fehlverhalten anhaltende Aufmerksamkeit erhält und Forderungen auslöst, dass die Verantwortlichen für ihre Handlungen Rechenschaft ablegen.

entries.ja: 一般的な立場や考え方として。ただし、個別の具体的な事例まで必ずしも支持するわけではない。
entries.ko: 일반적인 입장이나 신념으로서, 특정한 실제 사례까지 반드시 지지하는 것은 아님.
entries.zh-Hans: 作为一般性的立场或信念，但不一定支持某个具体的实际做法。
entries.es: Como postura o creencia general, sin apoyar necesariamente un caso concreto en la práctica.
entries.pt-BR: Como posição ou convicção geral, sem necessariamente apoiar um caso específico na prática.
entries.fr: En tant que position ou conviction générale, sans nécessairement soutenir un cas particulier dans la pratique.
entries.de: Als allgemeine Haltung oder Überzeugung, ohne damit zwangsläufig einen bestimmten konkreten Fall zu unterstützen.

entries.ja: 広く知られ、世間の注目を集める立場にあること。
entries.ko: 널리 알려져 있고 대중의 관심을 끄는 위치에 있는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 广为人知并处于引人关注的地位的状态。
entries.es: Condición de ser ampliamente reconocido y ocupar una posición que atrae la atención pública.
entries.pt-BR: Condição de ser amplamente conhecido e ocupar uma posição que atrai a atenção do público.
entries.fr: Fait d’être largement connu et d’occuper une position qui attire l’attention du public.
entries.de: Der Zustand, weithin bekannt zu sein und eine Stellung einzunehmen, die öffentliche Aufmerksamkeit auf sich zieht.

entries.ja: 何かを特定の捉え方で描写したもので、話し手の解釈を反映している場合がある。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 특정한 방식으로 묘사한 것으로, 말하는 사람의 해석이 반영될 수 있음.
entries.zh-Hans: 以某种特定方式描述事物的说法，可能反映说话者的理解。
entries.es: Descripción que presenta algo de una manera determinada y que puede reflejar la interpretación de quien habla.
entries.pt-BR: Descrição que apresenta algo de determinada maneira e pode refletir a interpretação de quem fala.
entries.fr: Description qui présente quelque chose d’une manière particulière et peut refléter l’interprétation de la personne qui s’exprime.
entries.de: Eine Beschreibung, die etwas auf eine bestimmte Weise darstellt und die Deutung der sprechenden Person widerspiegeln kann.

entries.ja: あるものに該当すること、またはそのように説明するために必要な本質的な特徴を備えていること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 해당하거나, 그렇게 설명할 수 있게 하는 본질적인 특징을 갖추는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 符合某种事物的判定条件，或具有使某种描述适用的本质特征。
entries.es: Reunir las condiciones para ser considerado algo o poseer las características esenciales que hacen aplicable esa descripción.
entries.pt-BR: Atender às condições para ser considerado algo ou ter as características essenciais que tornam essa descrição adequada.
entries.fr: Pouvoir être considéré comme quelque chose ou posséder les caractéristiques essentielles qui rendent cette description applicable.
entries.de: Als etwas gelten können oder die wesentlichen Merkmale besitzen, aufgrund derer diese Beschreibung zutrifft.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
